m01:room.title: The Molar Accounting Lab
m01:room.job: Count the carbon the plant holds, in the units the shift plan is written in.

m02:room.title: The Feed Stoichiometry Annex
m02:room.job: Find which feed runs out first in the Sabatier reactor.

m03:room.title: The Gas Systems Qualification Bay
m03:room.job: Work out whether the hydrogen line delivers what its gauge suggests.

m04:room.title: The Surface Spectroscopy Lab
m04:room.job: Name the element in the crust on the catalyst inlet.

m05:room.title: The Phase Separation Lab
m05:room.job: Work out what can cross the cold trap between the water loop and the reactor.

m06:room.title: The Corrosion Test Lab
m06:room.job: Find out what is happening at joint J-7, where two metals meet under a wet salt film.

m07:room.title: The Thermal Systems Lab
m07:room.job: Set the heat the Sabatier reaction makes against the heat the coolant takes away.

m08:room.title: The Kinetics Control Lab
m08:room.job: Find what the lower set point actually changed in the reaction.

m09:room.title: The Catalyst Diagnostics Bay
m09:room.job: Work out how long the hot hydrogen purge must run to clean chloride off the inlet nickel.

m10:room.title: The Thermodynamics Records Vault
m10:room.job: Test whether the lower set point harmed the bed or protected it.

m11:room.title: The Equilibrium Operations Lab
m11:room.job: Find where the Sabatier balance sits, and which knob moves it toward methane.

m12:room.title: The Water Recovery Pilot Hall
m12:room.job: Hold the recycle water at pH 7.00 for the electrolyzers.

m13:room.title: The Electrolysis Qualification Hall
m13:room.job: Work out how the stack makes the missing hydrogen on the power the arrays can spare.

m14:room.title: The Independent Propellant Assay
m14:room.job: Count the CO₂ in Tank C independently, by catching it as a solid and weighing it.

m15:room.title: The Launch Certification Office
m15:room.job: Sign off the methane and the oxygen the ascent engine is loaded with.
